extracted.name: Miso Soup with Shiitake Mushrooms
extracted.description: This delicious Japanese soup features with Shiitake mushrooms and tofu.
ingredient_lines: 2 green onions, trimmed and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan. Add mushrooms; reduce heat to low, and simmer 4 minutes.
Whisk miso paste and soy sauce together in a small bowl; stir into broth along with tofu and continue cooking 1 minute more. Divide soup among bowls; top with green onions to serve.
